overview: The Medford City Council met for its final regular meeting of 2015, honoring retiring Councilors Robert Penta and Paul Camuso as well as outgoing Mayor Michael McGlynn. The Council also acted on business district funding, senior parking exemptions, cable fee increases, and police commendations.

items.title: Medford Kiwanis Key Club Performance
items.summary: Members of the Medford Kiwanis Key Club performed Christmas carols for the council and audience.

items.title: Business District Improvement Funding
items.summary: The council tabled a request to transfer $250,000 from real estate sales for business district improvements to allow for further review by the economic development subcommittee.

items.title: Recognition of Retiring Councilor Robert M. Penta
items.summary: The council approved resolutions honoring Councilor Robert M. Penta for his 36 years of public service as the longest-serving city councilor in Medford history.

items.title: Recognition of Retiring Councilor Paul A. Camuso
items.summary: The council approved a resolution commending Councilor Paul A. Camuso on his 15 years of public service as an elected official in Medford.

items.title: Commendation of Retiring Mayor Michael J. McGlynn
items.summary: The council passed a resolution congratulating Mayor Michael J. McGlynn on his retirement after 28 years in office.

items.title: Senior Citizen Parking Exemption Resolution
items.summary: The council approved a resolution supporting a citywide parking fee exemption for senior citizens.

items.title: Recognition of Community Charitable Donors
items.summary: The council passed a resolution thanking local businesses, unions, and residents who donate to charitable causes in the city.

items.title: Comcast Cable Fee Increase and Public Access
items.summary: The council approved a resolution referring Comcast's cable access fee increase to the city solicitor and recommending it as a priority for the incoming administration.

items.title: School Department Savings and Discretionary Funds
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting reports from the superintendent regarding school budget savings and the status of mayoral discretionary funds for school projects.

items.title: Petition Regarding Mayoral Transition Team Vetting
items.summary: Council President Fred Dello Russo ruled a petition regarding the transition team of Mayor-elect Stephanie Muccini-Burke out of order, and his ruling was sustained on appeal.

items.title: Congratulating Wall Street Analyst Jonathan Gleona
items.summary: The council approved a resolution congratulating Medford High School graduate Jonathan Gleona for being named the most accurate Wall Street analyst by Bloomberg News.

items.title: Commendation of Police Officers Sheila Quinn and Paul Giordano
items.summary: The council approved a resolution congratulating Officers Sheila Quinn and Paul Giordano for rescuing a mother, infant twins, and a dog from a house fire.

items.title: Commendation of Retiring Water Commissioner Dominic Camara
items.summary: The council passed a resolution commending Dominic Camara upon his retirement after nine years on the Water Commission.

items.title: Condolences and Minutes Approvals
items.summary: The council expressed condolences to the family of Phyllis Makowski and approved the meeting minutes for December 8 and December 15, 2015.
